name: L'Alqueria de la Comtessa (Spain)
description: White field charged at the centre with the arms of L'Alqueria de la Comtessa (a red farmhouse between a palm and a tree on a brown ground).
history: Municipal flag of L'Alqueria de la Comtessa; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.
